decision_authority: This matrix does not authorize Core changes or source implementation. Core candidates require user approval; implementation requires separate authorization.

entries.name: TXT/EPUB/paste intake and parsing
entries.reason: Reuse parsers/encoding/structure algorithms behind PlotPilot Asset and Candidate contracts.

entries.name: Source cleaner data packages and package merge
entries.reason: Convert data-only rules to Data Plugin; keep deterministic merge provenance in a Code capability.

entries.name: Cleaning preview, thresholds, decisions and apply
entries.reason: Reuse delete-only engine, timeout and segment mapping; replace persistence and jobs.

entries.name: Source structure revision and publication
entries.reason: Preserve workflow and validation while Core owns Node/Revision/Publication.

entries.name: Four-class evidence rebind
risks: must never silently migrate ambiguous spans
unchanged is legal only for same-Revision/no-op
entries.reason: Preserve the four-class algorithm as a diagnostic inspect report; only deterministic rebound becomes a successor Candidate through a separate propose capability.

entries.name: Source search, span and evidence backlinks
risks: plugin cannot query Core DB directly
entries.reason: Keep search/evidence behavior; serve exact Core Revision spans through public query contracts.

entries.name: Book Atom extraction and typed review
entries.reason: Reuse taxonomy/validation/prompt behavior; all outputs become target Candidate items.

entries.name: Manual Atom and analysis exchange
risks: manual input must still produce provenance
entries.reason: Preserve manual/external flows without retaining donor HTTP or DB authority.

entries.name: Claim synthesis over accepted Atoms
entries.reason: Keep accepted-Atom authority, payload hash and acceptance ordinal validation.

entries.name: Book-analysis re-review
entries.reason: Preserve re-review lifecycle; Core controls Candidate decision and Publication.

entries.name: Narrative unit extraction
entries.reason: Reuse business model and prompt with target receipts.

entries.name: Narrative plan
risks: do not confuse business plan with Plugin Plan
entries.reason: Map user-selected scope/order/config to immutable target parameter Assets and Plan.

entries.name: Narrative synthesis
entries.reason: Use Broker child receipts and preserve per-source attribution.

entries.name: Character Atom/Card and asset import
risks: stored binding does not prove runtime participation
entries.reason: Reuse distillation model and validators; publish character documents/relations through Core.

entries.name: Character conflict adjudication
entries.reason: Keep conflict diagnostics and explicit user ruling; no automatic truth merge.

entries.name: Global template families and reusable derived assets
risks: generated package install may require CORE-CAND-010
entries.reason: Turn reusable results into Core Assets/Documents or immutable Data releases.

entries.name: Author style manufacture
risks: large source corpus and model cost
entries.reason: Reuse map/synthesis algorithms; style output is Data, method is Skill.

entries.name: Independent style qualification
entries.reason: Retain independent qualification and contradiction adjudication before publishing a style pack.

entries.name: Style runtime, review and refinement
risks: style pack/Skill/runtime identities must remain separate
entries.reason: Reuse capsule/input/review logic; output only Candidate or diagnostics.

entries.name: Independent consistency audit
entries.reason: Port as diagnostic-only capability with source evidence.

entries.name: Bounded impact analysis
entries.reason: Reuse bounded graph/evidence behavior; read only exact Core revisions.

entries.name: Controlled impact repair
entries.reason: Preserve per-item user choice and chapter-scoped repair Candidates.

entries.name: Branch fork
entries.reason: A plugin cannot create authoritative workspace identity under the frozen target contract.

entries.name: Branch Canon control
entries.reason: Port preflight and candidate generation after Core supplies branch/workspace identity.

entries.name: Chapter settlement lifecycle
entries.reason: Preserve reversible calculation and manual resolution, replace donor persistence.

entries.name: Foreshadow and story-state checks
risks: maturity is partial relative to broader story bible
entries.reason: Keep checks and UI behavior; formal facts/foreshadows remain Core authority.

entries.name: Creation workbench source binding and Recipe
risks: recipe and Plugin Plan semantics must stay distinct
entries.reason: Map workflow to target Plugin Plan, source refs and parameter Assets; do not copy UI.

entries.name: Outline/chapter outline/draft/refine/rewrite
entries.reason: Offer donor algorithms as alternative plugins/Skills without replacing current PlotPilot paths automatically.

entries.name: Continue generation
entries.reason: No complete donor vertical slice was proven; define anew over Core stream high-water/exact base.

entries.name: Memory and context retrieval
risks: plugin private DB cannot be formal memory truth
entries.reason: Reuse retrieval/context algorithms; private index must be rebuildable from Core.

entries.name: Skill install, execution, recommendation and attribution
entries.reason: Convert packages and behavior to target Skill identity/receipt contracts.

entries.name: Knowledge search and Obsidian projection
risks: external path handle forbidden to plugin
entries.reason: Generate Markdown Assets now; direct Vault projection waits for Core root-bound broker.

entries.name: OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini providers
risks: provider stream must remain Host behavior, not a fourth result contract
provider source paths must remain exclusive to NAP-00
entries.reason: Target v1.2 already owns OpenAI-compatible; native Anthropic and Gemini adapters remain distinct planned headless providers with frozen artifact result, Host needs and source owner.

entries.name: Declarative capability packages
entries.reason: Translate useful descriptors; do not copy donor registry or treat .naplugin as executable.

entries.name: Job/Event/recovery infrastructure
entries.reason: Reuse scenarios and fixtures only; a second job authority is forbidden.

entries.name: Candidate/current/backup infrastructure
entries.reason: Do not port donor DB or backup implementation.

entries.name: WebUI routes and workspace pages
entries.reason: Preserve user flows, epoch isolation and failure recovery; discard donor visual implementation.

entries.name: Outline visualization
entries.reason: Port tree/card/timeline/relation projection data; free-form canvas is not claimed.

entries.name: Development scripts, legacy compatibility and debug tools
risks: epub_to_txt script must not become alternate import path
entries.reason: No user plugin; adapt only narrowly useful validation fixtures.
